title: 寇府从容辞别
subtitle: 感谢好意，也记得自己的路
origin: 《西游记》第九十六回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 接受善意也要守住方向，温柔地说再见同样是一种尊重。
moral.en: Receiving kindness while keeping your direction—and saying goodbye gently—is also a form of respect.

pages.zh: 师徒在寇府住了几日，每天都给孩子们讲一个远方故事，再一起整理院子。
pages.en: The travelers stayed at the Kou home for several days, telling one faraway story each day and helping tidy the courtyard.
pages.prompt: Reuse the established five travelers and Elder Kou. In a bright courtyard, families listen to a travel story while Bajie sorts baskets, Sha sweeps leaves, and White Dragon Horse stands nearby; community warmth, no text.

pages.zh: 元宵将近，寇员外挂起花灯，想留他们看完灯会，再住十天。
pages.en: As the Lantern Festival approached, Elder Kou hung lanterns and hoped they would stay ten more days.
pages.prompt: Elder Kou hangs round blank silk lanterns across the courtyard and warmly invites the established travelers to stay; festive amber light, no writing on lanterns, no pressure or crowd.

pages.zh: 八戒舍不得香喷喷的汤圆，悟空也喜欢灯影。可唐僧摊开通关文牒，提醒大家西行还没有完成。
pages.en: Bajie hated to leave the sweet rice balls, and Wukong loved the lantern glow. Tang Seng opened their travel pass and reminded them that the westward journey was not finished.
pages.prompt: The established team sits around a table with a small bowl of rice balls and blank travel papers. Tang Seng points gently westward, Wukong and Bajie listen thoughtfully, no readable text or disappointment.

pages.zh: 他们商量出一个办法：陪寇家点亮第一盏灯，第二天清晨就出发。
pages.en: They found a kind solution: light the first lantern with the Kou family, then leave at dawn.
pages.prompt: The established team and Elder Kou jointly light one large blank lantern using a safe enclosed candle; everyone smiles at the agreed plan, evening blue and gold palette, no fire hazard.

pages.zh: 寇员外准备了许多金银，唐僧只收下一包干粮。悟空说：“轻装，才能走远。”
pages.en: Elder Kou offered gold and silver, but Tang Seng accepted only one packet of food. Wukong said, "Travel light, and you can travel far."
pages.prompt: Elder Kou offers a closed decorative chest, while Tang Seng kindly chooses one simple cloth food bundle; Wukong lifts the light bundle with a smile; respectful equal eye level, no visible coins or greed.

pages.zh: 八戒把最爱的汤圆留给寇家的小朋友，沙僧把修屋用的工具摆回原处。
pages.en: Bajie left his favorite rice balls for the Kou children, while Sha returned every repair tool to its place.
pages.prompt: Bajie offers a covered bowl of rice balls to children beside caregivers; Sha Wujing neatly returns rounded repair tools to a rack; the rest of the team packs calmly, no unattended children.

pages.zh: 第一盏花灯亮起时，寇员外没有再挽留，只把一盏小路灯递给他们。
pages.en: When the first festival lantern glowed, Elder Kou no longer asked them to stay. He simply gave them a small road lantern.
pages.prompt: Elder Kou gives Tang Seng a small closed road lantern under a canopy of blank festival lanterns; the established team bows in thanks, tender farewell without tears or pressure.

pages.zh: 天刚亮，师徒踏上西去的路。寇家人站在门前挥手，灯光虽远，心意一直暖着。
pages.en: At first light, the travelers returned to the western road. The Kou family waved from the gate, and their kindness stayed warm even as the lantern faded behind.
pages.prompt: Wide sunrise farewell: the established travelers walk west along a gentle road while Elder Kou and family wave from the gate; a tiny warm lantern glows, spacious hopeful landscape, no sadness.
